concept_zh: 主线五段验收链（开源 PR 语义 ↔ 可验证公共语义）
concept_en: Mainline five-stage acceptance chain (open-source PR semantics ↔ verifiable public semantics)

stages.git_semantics: open an issue / push a proposal branch
stages.requirement_zh: 目的、范围、数据源与退出条件公开提交；问题以 issue 形式公开登记

stages.git_semantics: pull request review by maintainers and public
stages.requirement_zh: 公示与意见征集（Merge 评审月），采纳情况留痕；四段契约与状态机不可跳过
stages.verifiable_public: gates C0-C4 pass; public review record traceable

stages.requirement_zh: 仅获授权的限时增益；可回退切换开日志公开审计

stages.git_semantics: revert to a previous commit / tag
stages.requirement_zh: 真实拔线模型/网络/传感器/自动执行器；演练不可跳过
stages.verifiable_public: unplug action executed; recovery evidence collected

stages.git_semantics: archive the release and tag a stable line
stages.requirement_zh: 验收离线公共红利是否仍独立可用；公开复盘与版本存档
stages.verifiable_public: bequest usable + maintained by responsible party; audit closed

slogan_zh: Merge must be reversible（合入必须可合回）。
